description: Na₂YTaSi₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-3.01 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.86 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.34 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.18 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-35°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.72 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.72 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-38°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ta and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
